name: Template library zoom tour
looks: A dim section title sits over a blurred wall of template thumbnails. The blur clears and the camera settles on a dense, varied grid of real page layouts (hero sections, galleries, profile cards, pricing panels), filling the frame several rows deep, reading as one large catalogue rather than a few examples.
build: The title dissolves out on the clock as the background layer's blur radius tweens to 0 (gaussian filter animated). The grid is a world container of DOM cards at fixed positions; a slow, even camera drift (translate + slight scale) across it sells the sense of a much larger catalogue beyond the frame.
sound: A soft shift under the blur clearing, with a low ambient bed under the grid.
prompt: Prove a library is large: hold a section title over a blurred wall of samples, let the blur resolve into a dense grid of many real, varied layouts filling the frame, and drift the camera slowly across it so the catalogue reads as bigger than what fits on screen.
